verdict.rationale: The only direct bulk evidence is batch shipping label creation of up to 250 labels at once (shopify-docs-12). The Admin GraphQL API and GraphiQL can run queries and mutations programmatically (shopify-docs-31, shopify-docs-x3), but nothing in the pack documents bulk operations across many items. missing for 10: documented bulk operations API for products/orders/inventory, bulk edit across item types, agent/MCP-driven bulk actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
